authoritative_source.provider: Esri India ArcGIS Living Atlas of India
authoritative_source.service_spatial_reference: EPSG:102100 (Web Mercator); geometry requested as EPSG:4326 via outSR
official_attributes_carried: lgd_districtcode (Government of India Local Government Directory code)

publication_window: 2024 boundaries (vintage reflects LGD status including Vijayanagara, created 2021, and the 2023 renaming of Ramanagara to Bengaluru South)

licence.status: not explicitly published on the service or item metadata
licence.note: Only ArcGIS platform access terms apply. Before any redistribution, confirm terms with Esri India / the publisher. Survey of India Administrative Boundary Database (the primary official source) requires portal registration and could not be programmatically accessed.

derived_file.declared_crs: EPSG:7755 (WGS 84 / India NSF LCC, metres, easting/northing)
derived_file.transform: EPSG:4326 -> EPSG:7755, PyProj Transformer.with always_xy=True, round-trip validated in scripts/build_karnataka_districts.py
derived_file.api_output_crs: EPSG:4326 (longitude first, latitude second), produced by the backend with PyProj always_xy=True
derived_file.attribute_policy: All source attributes preserved unchanged; no synthetic or estimated values added.

cross_check_vs_legacy_nwic.notes: Vijayanagara (738) exists only in the new source. Legacy Ballari spans ~2x the new Ballari area because Vijayanagara was carved from it. Bengaluru South (IAB2024) overlaps legacy Ramanagara by 99.5% (official 2023 rename). Davanagere shows a small northern sliver difference between sources.

prior_source_archive.description: NWIC 'District Boundary' (733 India districts), legacy 30-district Karnataka subset, kept for traceability.

verification_limits: No polygon-level overlay against an authoritative Survey of India shapefile was performed (SOI portal requires registration).
Esri India Living Atlas service metadata does not publish a licence or upstream boundary producer statement; LGD/Census code attributes are the official-attribution evidence.
